description:
Retrieval golden set over the SERVING corpus only — the 14 verified documents a real user's question can actually reach. No fixture issuers. Written 2026-07-31 after the owner asked how a benchmark over invented banks could say anything about real queries; it cannot, and the existing 24-query set is 17/24 about demo_bank and sample_bank.

Labelling discipline: expected_doc_ids were assigned by reading each document's own section headings, BEFORE running retrieval. Labelling from what the retriever returns would make the benchmark agree with itself by construction and measure nothing.

Queries are phrased the way a cardholder would ask, not as keyword bags — testing semantic search on natural language is the whole point.

Split into two tiers (2026-07-31). The first 20 name the card, which is how people usually ask — and scored a flattering 1.000 because naming a card makes the issuer obvious. The h-tier deliberately does not name one, which is where retrieval has to work from meaning alone. A benchmark that always passes teaches nothing.

queries.query: How many EDGE Miles does my Axis Atlas earn per 100 rupees I spend?
What rate does the Atlas give if I book a flight directly with the airline?
Which airlines can I move my EDGE Miles to?
queries.why: 'transfer partners Group A / Group B' sections

queries.query: What is the smallest number of EDGE Miles I am allowed to transfer at once?
queries.why: 'Axis Atlas transfer caps and minimum' section

queries.query: What spending does not earn anything on the Atlas card?
What is one EDGE Mile actually worth?
How many reward points does the HDFC Infinia give me for everyday spending?
How much extra do I earn booking a hotel through SmartBuy on my Infinia?
Is there a monthly limit on how many bonus points I can earn on the Infinia?
What does the Infinia cost each year and can the fee be waived?
Which frequent flyer programmes accept HDFC reward points?
What is an HDFC reward point worth if I use it for travel?
queries.why: 'HDFC Reward Points value by redemption channel' section

queries.query: How many Membership Rewards points does the Amex Platinum Travel earn?
How many airport lounge visits do I get with my Platinum Travel card?
What do I get for hitting the spending milestones on the Platinum Travel?
Which airlines can I send my Amex Membership Rewards points to?
What is the yearly fee on the Amex Platinum Travel?
Am I charged a surcharge when I buy petrol with my Platinum Travel?
queries.why: 'Amex Platinum Travel fuel convenience fee' section

queries.query: Does the Amex Reward Multiplier portal earn me more points?
Which of my cards earns the most on flights?
queries.why: A comparison question: all three P1 reward-rule documents are relevant

queries.query: what do I get at the airport
queries.why: Lounge access is the airport benefit and lives only in the benefit guide

queries.query: can I turn my points into airline miles
is there a limit on how many bonus points I can earn
queries.why: 'monthly reward caps' is the only cap section in the corpus

queries.query: what does this card cost me every year
queries.why: The two documents with a fees section

queries.query: does buying groceries earn me anything
queries.why: Exclusion sections are where non-earning spend is defined

queries.query: which card should I use to book a hotel
queries.why: An earning comparison — reward rules, not transfer rules
